source.name: Crónica Global (Culemanía): Laporta diversifica els patrocinadors de les seccions — Assistència Sanitària perd pes mentre el Barça busca soci per al nou Palau
source.quote: L'equip de bàsquet encara conservarà el logotip de la companyia asseguradora catalana en el curs 26-27.
source.note: Placement on the front of the chest per the club store's photos of the 2026/27 EuroLeague home jersey (https://store.fcbarcelona.com/cdn/shop/files/FOTOSECOMMERCEBASKETBRIZUELA.png, product page https://store.fcbarcelona.com/products/mens-basketball-jersey-home-kit-26-27); the away jersey's product photos likewise show the logo on the chest. EgyptAir, the club's new main partner, takes the handball front, not the basketball shirt.

source.name: Crónica Global (Culemanía): Laporta diversifica els patrocinadors de les seccions — Assistència Sanitària perd pes mentre el Barça busca soci per al nou Palau
source.quote: El soci blaugrana encara apareix com a patrocinador principal dels esports indoor, només per darrere de Nike.
source.note: Kit maker, recorded as partner per existing convention: the Nike logo sits on the chest of the 2026/27 home jersey, above the Assistència Sanitària wordmark (https://store.fcbarcelona.com/cdn/shop/files/FOTOSECOMMERCEBASKETBRIZUELA.png).

summary: 2026/27 home (EuroLeague) jersey: Assistència Sanitària across the front of the chest (Crónica Global, 30 Aug 2026: the basketball team keeps the insurer's logo in 2026-27; club store photos show it under the Nike logo and the centenary crest), with Nike as kit maker. Not complete: the club store's back-view photo of the jersey (https://store.fcbarcelona.com/cdn/shop/files/Home-basket.jpg) shows the Barça Foundation logo above the back number, but no club or press text source names the Foundation on the back of the basketball shirt; the home shorts (https://store.fcbarcelona.com/cdn/shop/files/IW2583-498_1.jpg) carry no sponsor beyond the Nike swoosh and the club crest; the badge on the other side of the chest is the EuroLeague's own mark with its partner Etihad (see the euroleague-etihad deal), not a club sponsor.
